Business Cloud Drive India — Secure File Sharing

What is XcellHost Cloud Drive? XcellHost Cloud Drive is a secure business file-storage, sync and collaboration service for Indian organisations. It gives teams centrally managed folders, version history, access controls and protected external sharing across devices, with pooled storage hosted in Indian data centres and local migration and support from XcellHost’s Mumbai team.

Overview

Cloud Drive by XcellHost is a secure cloud-based file storage and collaboration solution that enables businesses to store, access, share, and manage their important files from anywhere, anytime. It eliminates dependency on traditional file servers while providing enterprise-grade security, centralized control, and seamless collaboration. Dropbox-style file share and sync, but with your data in Indian datacenters under your control. Team folders, external sharing links, version history and device sync — minus the compliance headaches.

Security and operations

How does Cloud Drive protect business files?

AES-256 encryption protects stored data while TLS 1.2/1.3 protects transfers. Administrators can apply role-based access, multi-factor authentication, audit logging, file versioning and password- or expiry-protected sharing. The published SLA commits to 99.9% platform uptime and 24×7 emergency support.

Frequently asked questions

XcellHost Cloud Drive is a business file-storage, sync and collaboration service with centrally managed users, team folders, version history and controlled external sharing. It is designed for organisations that need company-managed storage instead of files scattered across personal drives, email and messaging apps.

Plans start at ₹2,499 per customer per month for 250 GB of pooled storage and unlimited users. Published prices exclude GST. Larger plans provide 500 GB, 1 TB, 2 TB or 5 TB, with discounted three-month, six-month and annual billing.

Storage is pooled for the customer rather than assigned as a fixed allowance per user. The organisation chooses a 250 GB to 5 TB plan and can create unlimited users, while administrators control folders, permissions and storage use.

The standard XcellHost Cloud Drive offer stores customer data in Indian data centres. Confirm the selected region, backup arrangement and any sector-specific residency requirement in the service order before activation.

The published File Cloud SLA specifies AES-256 encryption for data at rest and TLS 1.2 or 1.3 for data in transit. It also lists role-based access, multi-factor authentication, audit logging and password- or expiry-protected sharing.

Indian data residency, access controls, audit logs and controlled sharing can support an organisation’s DPDPA security and governance measures. No storage product guarantees compliance by itself; customers must configure access, retention and lawful processing for their own obligations.

Cloud Drive provides pooled organisation-level storage, unlimited users on the published plans, Indian data residency and local XcellHost migration and support. Google Drive and OneDrive are tightly integrated with their respective productivity suites and are commonly licensed per user.

Yes. XcellHost can scope migration from file servers and common cloud-drive platforms, including folder structure, permissions and cutover planning. Timing and migration method depend on data volume, source-platform access, internet bandwidth and the condition of the source data.
